dct_creator_sm: Miatta, Marta (Memorial University of Newfoundland). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5288-730X
dct_description_sm: This repository contains data on macrofauna and environmental variables from 11 stations within the Laurentian Channel MPA sampled in September 2017 and July 2018 to assess the role of sea pen octocorals for macrofaunal communities at small and large scale.

dct_title_s: Data from: Sea pens affect macrofaunal communities in deep-sea sediments: Evidence from the Laurentian Channel Marine Protected Area
